# Governance Doctor Audit and Guide

Use this source material to describe read-only Governance Doctor Audit and Guide
facts. It contains no Repair behavior and does not create authority to change a
destination.

The profile is canonical data. Its identifiers name only the closed read-only
AIH surfaces represented by the profile contract. It describes reviewing
precomputed AIH-produced read-only diagnostic results. Findings and guidance
remain source-attributed and non-authoritative.

Scaffolding copies this first-party source into a destination. The destination
lifecycle is responsible for subsequent governance and approval before any use.
